Optional file lets you quickly switch between different portrait and dialogue box sizes with GMCM or config.json. Installed as independent mod. Mostly meant for mobiles but also may be used to make Mud's and TwoCircles's mods use identical offsets.Six offsets available: two original from both skimpy mods, medium (for 440dp screens) and small (for 360dp screens). Enabled vertical toolbar messes with dialogues x offset so choose one on your preferences. Just keep in mind that during cutscenes and festivals toolbar is hidden, so dialogue position will be shifted.
